Advent of Code

My Java puzzle solutions, with tools for selecting puzzles, testing results, and tracking progress.

Public source

Puzzle selection and testing

I use Gradle tasks and reusable test utilities to select unsolved puzzles and check solutions across several puzzle years.

Progress and automation

The repository includes performance tracking, caching, an HTML progress dashboard, and Playwright automation. I also experiment with GitHub Copilot as part of the puzzle-solving workflow.
